articles.title: Clearway Energy, Inc. Increases Quarterly Dividend to $0.4602 per Share
articles.summary: PRINCETON, N.J., Feb. 17, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Clearway Energy, Inc. (NYSE: CWEN, CWEN.A) today announced that on February 17, 2026, its Board of Directors declared a quarterly dividend on each of the Company’s Class A and Class C common stock of $0.4602 per share payable on March 16, 2026, to shareholders of record as of March 2, 2026. This quarterly dividend represents $1.8408 per share on an annualized basis, an increase of 1.6% over the fourth quarter 2025 dividend of $0.4528 per share,
